web.title: Web
web.description: Configure the base URL and authentication credentials for the web server.
web.baseUrlHelp: The public URL where SolidPing is accessible.
web.jwtSecretHelp: Used to sign authentication tokens. Changing this will invalidate all existing sessions.

mail.title: Mail
mail.description: Configure SMTP email settings for notifications and invitations.

test.title: Test Email
test.description: Send a test email to verify your SMTP configuration is working.

auth.title: Authentication Settings
auth.helpText: Credential changes take effect after a server restart. The Enabled toggle takes effect immediately for the login page once saved.
auth.samlSpInfo: Give these URLs to your IdP administrator to configure the SAML connection.

fieldHelp.tenantId: Your Entra directory (tenant) ID, or a verified domain. Leave blank for "common" (multi-tenant). Use "organizations" or "consumers" to restrict account types.
fieldHelp.displayName: Shown on the login button, e.g. "Continue with Company IdP". Defaults to "SSO" when blank.
fieldHelp.issuerUrl: The OIDC issuer URL, e.g. https://idp.example.com/realms/acme. Discovery is performed against "{issuer URL}/.well-known/openid-configuration".
fieldHelp.scopes: Space-separated OAuth2 scopes. "openid" is always included. Defaults to "openid email profile" when blank.
fieldHelp.emailClaim: ID token claim used for the user's email. Defaults to "email".
fieldHelp.nameClaim: ID token claim used for the user's display name. Defaults to "name".
fieldHelp.avatarClaim: ID token claim used for the user's avatar URL. Defaults to "picture".
fieldHelp.idpMetadataUrl: The identity provider's metadata URL, fetched (and cached) to learn its SSO endpoint and signing certificate. Leave blank if you paste the metadata XML directly below.
fieldHelp.idpMetadataXml: Pasted IdP metadata XML, used instead of fetching the URL above when set. Takes precedence over the URL when both are provided.
fieldHelp.spEntityId: Overrides this SP's entity ID as advertised in its own metadata. Defaults to the metadata URL below when blank.
fieldHelp.emailAttribute: Assertion attribute used for the user's email. Falls back to common attribute names (email, mail, ...) and then to the NameID when it looks like an email address.
fieldHelp.nameAttribute: Assertion attribute used for the user's display name. Falls back to common attribute names (cn, displayName, ...).
fieldHelp.serverUrl: LDAP server URL, e.g. ldap://ldap.example.com:389 or ldaps://ldap.example.com:636 for LDAPS.
fieldHelp.startTls: Upgrade a plain ldap:// connection to TLS after connecting. Ignored for ldaps:// URLs, which are already encrypted.
fieldHelp.insecureSkipVerify: Skip TLS certificate verification. Only use for testing against a self-signed certificate — this allows man-in-the-middle attacks.
fieldHelp.bindDn: Distinguished Name of the service account used to search the directory, e.g. cn=admin,dc=example,dc=com. Leave blank for an anonymous (unauthenticated) search bind.
fieldHelp.baseDn: Base DN to search for users under, e.g. ou=people,dc=example,dc=com.
fieldHelp.userFilter: LDAP filter template with one "%s" placeholder for the submitted username (escaped before substitution), e.g. (sAMAccountName=%s). Defaults to (mail=%s) when blank.

hashing.title: Password Hashing
hashing.description: Choose the algorithm and cost used to hash local passwords. Stronger settings slow down offline cracking but cost more CPU per login.
hashing.restartNotice: Changes take effect after a server restart. New passwords then use the new profile; existing users are migrated on their next sign-in when re-hashing is enabled. Values configured via YAML or environment variables are not shown here — leave a field blank to inherit the server default.
hashing.algorithmHelp: argon2id is the recommended modern default; bcrypt is offered for compatibility.

presets.label: Recommended profiles
presets.help: Presets fill the argon2id fields with an OWASP-aligned profile. Pick one, then adjust if needed.

argon2.memoryHelp: Memory cost in KiB. Minimum 8192; OWASP recommends at least 19456 (19 MiB).
argon2.timeHelp: Number of passes over memory. Minimum 1.
argon2.threadsHelp: Lanes used while hashing. Between 1 and 255.
argon2.saltLengthHelp: Random salt length in bytes. Minimum 8.

bcrypt.costHelp: bcrypt work factor. Between 10 and 31; 12 or higher is recommended.

rehash.label: Re-hash existing passwords on next sign-in
rehash.help: When on, a stored hash that no longer matches this policy is transparently upgraded on the user's next successful password login. When off, only new passwords use the new profile.

performance.title: Performance
performance.subtitle: Configure performance-related parameters.
performance.description: Configure the number of concurrent workers for checks and jobs. Changes take effect after server restart.
performance.checkRunnersHelp: Number of concurrent goroutines for running health checks.
performance.jobRunnersHelp: Number of concurrent goroutines for processing background jobs.
performance.fastLaneReservedHelp: Check runner slots reserved for fast checks: slow checks (cost ≥ 2s) can never occupy more than Check Runners minus this many slots. Takes effect after restart.
performance.checkRunnersGroupHelp: The pool that executes checks. The fast-lane reservation is carved out of this same pool.
performance.fastLaneReservedTooHigh: Must be smaller than the total check runners.
performance.laneLoadDescription: Server-computed offered load per worker and lane. Duty is the sum of per-check duty cycles: 100% ≈ one permanently occupied runner slot; a lane whose duty exceeds its slot capacity is running behind.

emailInbox.title: Email Inbox
emailInbox.description: Configure the shared JMAP inbox used by passive email checks. Fastmail, Stalwart, and other JMAP-capable providers are supported.
emailInbox.pollIntervalHelp: Used as a safety net when JMAP push fails or isn't supported. Default 900 s (15 min).
emailInbox.rewriteBaseUrlHelp: Used to substitute the JMAP server's published base URL when behind a reverse proxy.

status.title: Status
status.description: Live state of the JMAP supervisor.

slack.title: Slack
slack.subtitle: Configure Slack Socket Mode connectivity for outgoing event delivery.

socketMode.title: Socket Mode
socketMode.description: Connect to Slack over an outgoing WebSocket instead of public webhooks. Requires an App-Level Token (xapp-…) from the Slack App configuration.
socketMode.notEnabledHint: Slack integration is not enabled. Configure it under Authentication settings or set SP_SLACK_ENABLED=true.
socketMode.restartHint: Changes take effect after the server restarts.

status.title: Connection Status
status.description: Live state of the Slack Socket Mode supervisor.
